resolved_conflicts.explanation: The museum description says 100 ft and the museum's other-names field says 110 ft. No other source found settles it, so the story gives both figures.
Burns names the Evangeline Ranger District. The Forest Service now lists the Evangeline Unit of the Calcasieu Ranger District.
The 1935 date is for a museum copy of a CCC photograph, and the 1937 date is for a set of history photos. Neither gives a construction year, so they do not conflict.

notes_for_editor: Build year, fate and current status are not in any source found. The Central US Lookouts page cites a 1935 National Archives photo captioned as a 110-foot tower, but that caption is not in the cached page text, so it is not used or quoted. The Burns history is OCR text with errors; quotes are copied as extracted. The Gardner tower is not on the NHLR, FFLOS or Wikipedia Louisiana lists. The OpenStreetMap node is a volunteer map record only.
